## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::NotOraclePublisher` — the caller is not an authorized oracle publisher.

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::oracle_publisher_rotation`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::oracle_publisher_rotation). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// NotOraclePublisher — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let pub1 = soroban_sdk::Address::generate(&f.env);
let unauthorized = soroban_sdk::Address::generate(&f.env);
let mut pubs = soroban_sdk::Vec::new(&f.env);
pubs.push_back(pub1);
f.client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .set_oracle_config(&f.governor, &pubs, &1, &3600);
let now = f.env.ledger().timestamp();
Some(rejected!(f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_submit_oracle_time(&unauthorized, &now)))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked oracle_publisher_rotation
```

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Call `submit_oracle_time` from an address in the configured publisher set; rotate the set through governance if the caller should be authorized.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#16-oracle-reference-clock--staleness-bounds`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#16-oracle-reference-clock--staleness-bounds)
